equation: dX(t) = mu * X(t) * dt + sigma * X(t) * dW(t)
diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = sigma  (scalar 1D: g(X) = sigma*X, so dg/dX = sigma)
milstein_correction: 0.5 * sigma * X_n * sigma * (dW**2 - dt)  =  0.5 * sigma**2 * X_n * (dW**2 - dt)
implementation_notes: Standard multiplicative scalar GBM. Ito interpretation. X stays positive given X_0 > 0, so no positivity guard needed. Milstein eligible (scalar, multiplicative, dg/dX = sigma in closed form). Analytic mean at T=1: X_0*exp(mu*T) = exp(0.1) ~= 1.1052; analytic variance ~= exp(0.2)*(exp(0.04)-1) ~= 0.04987.
